items.summary: The best game so far I've stumbled across in a while, Oh boy! Can't get enough of the unique art style, rewards are generous... And the best part? I'm not gonna get tired of Morimens.... Highly recommend if you're seeking a unique art style that no other Gacha games have.
items.author: Justin Baguio
